entities.summary: Counter-Reformation & Thirty Years' War, a transformative movement in Austria (1555–1648). Emerged from First Siege of Vienna by Suleiman the Magnificent and Battle of Mohács and fall of Hungary. Catalyzed Battle of Vienna – Sobieski's cavalry charge breaks the siege and Habsburg reconquest of Hungary sealed by the Treaty.
